name: grant_admin_loan_product_writes
statements:
-- Allow the `authenticated` role to write loan_products at the table level.
-- Row-level security still restricts these operations to admins via the
-- existing "Admins manage loan products" policy (has_role('admin')).
grant insert, update, delete on public.loan_products to authenticated;

name: admin_update_users_policy
grant_update_users_to_authenticated
statements: grant update on public.users to authenticated;
